name: Gluteal Tendinopathy Rehabilitation Protocol
description: Evidence-based 12-week protocol for gluteal tendinopathy (Greater Trochanteric Pain Syndrome) with progressive gluteal loading
pain_rule: Pain max. 3/10 during the exercise. Avoid lying on the affected side and crossing legs.
evidence_base: Mellor et al. (2018): Exercise superior to corticosteroid injection and wait-and-see at 12 months
Grimaldi & Fearon (2015): Gluteal tendinopathy management framework
Ganderton et al. (2017): Progressive resistance training for gluteal tendinopathy
Cook & Purdam (2009): Tendon load management principles
progression_criteria: Single-leg stand for 30 seconds without pain
Lying on affected side without pain

exercises.name: Isometric Bridge
exercises.description: Supine, lift hips and hold. Actively engage glutes, knees hip-width apart
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and gluteal muscle activation

exercises.name: Isometric Standing Abduction
exercises.description: Standing sideways against wall, push affected leg against wall without movement
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and gluteal muscle activation

exercises.name: Weighted Hip Bridge
exercises.description: Supine, weight on pelvis. Slowly lift hips and lower with control
exercises.phase_goal: Build gluteal strength and promote tendon adaptation

exercises.name: Side-Lying Abduction
exercises.description: Side-lying, raise upper leg straight. Slow and controlled. No hip rotation
exercises.phase_goal: Build gluteal strength and promote tendon adaptation

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bridge
exercises.description: Supine, lift hips on one leg. Keep pelvis stable, do not let it tilt
exercises.phase_goal: Build gluteal strength and promote tendon adaptation

exercises.name: Lateral Step-Up
exercises.description: Lateral step-up onto a step (20-30cm). Step up with control and lower slowly
exercises.phase_goal: Improve daily load tolerance and gait pattern

exercises.name: Single-Leg Squat
exercises.description: Single-leg squat, keep pelvis stable. Align knee over foot
exercises.phase_goal: Improve daily load tolerance and gait pattern
